goal: Deliver and verify a resumable command-line feature.
intent: Implement the feature with direct tests and preserve enough evidence for a fresh agent to resume safely.

success_criteria.statement: The feature behavior is implemented and its direct test passes.
success_criteria.expected_evidence: Passing command output tied to the declared feature check.

success_criteria.statement: A fresh agent can identify the next action and open risk.
success_criteria.expected_evidence: Canonical resume projection from the journal.

constraints.statement: Do not deploy or contact external systems.

stop_conditions: Stop if direct tests cannot run in the available environment.
